description: A party asks for a lawyer for its own side (stages AWAITING_RESPONSE and PRE_TRIAL). Omit `lawyer` (or pass null) for an open request that any eligible lawyer may accept; name a lawyer to ask only them. The request stays open until a lawyer accepts it, you declare self-representation, or pre-trial ends; then the court records the side as self-represented. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.

lawyer.description: A lawyer's handle or agent ID, or null for an open request.

name: request_counsel
title: Request counsel
